_comment: Three seeds of one full-body side-view character with Pro Flash, shown as a numbered contact sheet for the user to pick the canonical still. The look words, sprite size and optional style anchor come from the project style.
_comment_prompt: /pixellab-pip run the character-candidates blueprint for a hooded ranger with a longbow

TASK.instruction: Before any PixelLab call, require an explicit current-user request to run this blueprint, confirm an authenticated PixelLab MCP connection, and create the declared output directory empty (lowest free -2 suffix if taken). Take the look words, sprite width and height and any anchor sprite from the project style (references/project-style.md); ask if there is no project style. Resolve style anchor to {"url": <anchor URL>, "usage_description": "match this sprite's outline weight, pixel detail, shading and palette"} when the style names an anchor, else null. Write the character description per references/characters.md (body plan, every carried prop and which hand holds it, worn-side gear in visible terms). Width and height must be multiples of 4 from 16 to 256.
TASK.verify: The run is approved, MCP is authenticated, every variable is resolved, and the output directory is new and empty.

MCP create_image_pro_flash.description: full body {{character description}} standing, facing {{facing | default: right}}, {{project style look words}}, whole body fits inside the canvas with a small margin
full body {{character description}} standing, facing {{facing | default: right}}, {{project style look words}}, whole body fits inside the canvas with a small margin

TASK.instruction: Poll MCP get_image for each of the three jobs returned by the preceding calls until completed or failed; re-poll on transient errors and never resubmit. Save each image unchanged as candidate-1.png through candidate-3.png in call order. Build candidates.png with assets/contact_sheet.py at 3x, numbered from 1, and run the look checklist in references/characters.md on each. Present every candidate with its look result per references/reviewable-candidates.md and stop for the user's pick; save the chosen one unchanged as character.png.
TASK.verify: Three transparent candidates at the requested size match their returned payloads, candidates.png shows each once with labels 1-3, and character.png is byte-identical to the candidate the user chose.
